rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for damaging a person's reputation.

example.english: They keep trying to discredit people behind their backs.
example.traditional: 佢哋成日喺人哋背後抹黑人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 jan4 dei6 bui3 hau6 maat3 hak1 jan4

rows.note: Use this when evidence or an idea is challenged so that people doubt its truth or reliability.

example.english: Some people discredit this theory by questioning its credibility.
example.traditional: 有人質疑呢個理論嘅可信性。
example.jyutping: jau5 jan4 zat1 ji4 ni1 go3 lei5 leon6 ge3 ho2 seon3 sing3
